title: Kimchi Fried Rice
description: Kimchi fried rice is a delicious way to use leftover rice and kimchi; spice things up with Korean chile paste and top with a fried egg for a quick and easy dinner.
ingredients: 1 green onion, sliced, white and green parts separated
1 tablespoon gochujang (Korean hot pepper paste), or to taste

steps.text: Heat canola oil in large nonstick skillet over high heat. Add ground beef and green onion white parts; reduce heat to medium. Cook and stir until beef is browned and onion is fragrant, 1 to 2 minutes.

Stir kimchi and gochujang into beef mixture; cook until warmed through and fragrant, 2 to 4 minutes. Add rice; cook and stir until rice is heated through and coated with gochujang, 3 to 5 minutes more.
Drizzle sesame oil over rice mixture; stir to coat. Garnish with green onion green parts.
Melt 1 teaspoon butter in a skillet over medium-high heat. Crack egg into the skillet; cook until white is completely set and yolk is thick, 3 to 4 minutes. Place egg over fried rice.

video.description: Turn up the heat on your fried rice favorite with the spicy kick of kimchi. Perfect for lunch, weeknight dinner or late night cravings, fried rice tossed with hamburger and fried egg is delicious and easy to make.
